headline: Executive order directs the federal government to favor Opportunity Zones and other struggling communities when choosing locations for federal sites.
what_it_does: Based on its title, this order tells the federal government to aim for Opportunity Zones and other economically distressed areas when deciding where to put federal offices and facilities. Opportunity Zones are low-income areas named under a 2017 tax law. No summary was provided, so the exact rules, agencies involved, and limits are not clear from the source.

who_it_affects.group: Federal agencies that choose sites for offices and facilities
who_it_affects.how: They are directed to consider or prioritize Opportunity Zones and other distressed communities when picking locations.

who_it_affects.group: Residents and local businesses in Opportunity Zones and other low-income areas
who_it_affects.how: Their communities may be more likely to be chosen as locations for new or moved federal sites.

when_it_takes_effect: Signed August 24, 2020; executive orders usually take effect when signed unless they say otherwise.
